content:
The map confirms: row y=3 is wall except x=11. The rock at (11,4) sits directly below the gap (11,3). So the only way to (11,3) is from (11,2) above — unreachable — or through the rock.

The rock must be breakable. In Stardew-like games, rocks are broken with a pickaxe. My toolbar has Hoe, Watering Can, Seeds — no pickaxe. But maybe the hoe works with repeated hits, or maybe the rock is a "Rockslide" that needs clearing. Let me try hitting it multiple times with the hoe.
